This plot is very small, just a little piece near the house, so I will not waste money buying a full bag of fertilizer for it — one bag is too much for this size and I need my cash for my bigger plots. I will put some manure from my goats and chickens on it because that costs me nothing. I will use the seed I saved from last year like I always do, and my wife and I will work it ourselves when we have time between the bigger fields.
